methodologyNotes: Roster covers 13 high-search baby bassinet models spanning standalone, bedside/co-sleeper, smart-rocking, and convertible-crib categories sold in the US as of June 2026. Specs were re-verified for this revision against official brand product pages (happiestbaby.com, halosleep.com, chiccousa.com, cradlewise.com, babybjorn.com, armsreach.com, nunababy.com, target.com/4moms, dreamonme.com, kids2.com, service.mattel.com) and cross-checked against major retailers (Target, Amazon, Walmart, Albee Baby) and review aggregators. Prices are published US MSRP or a confirmed first-party/authorized-retailer price; priceNote flags variation. Booleans indicate presence/absence; null means the spec could not be confirmed from available sources (a null beats a guess). Weight limits in pounds (lb); height ranges in inches (in). All products independently re-verified; corrections recorded in provenance. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: SNOO Smart Sleeper
products.priceNote: MSRP new (happiestbaby.com); certified pre-loved lower; rental option available

specs.rocking_motion: automatic side-to-side, escalating soothing levels triggered by cry detection

products.provenance: Re-verified: $1,695 MSRP confirmed via search of happiestbaby.com listings and retailers; 25 lb weight limit confirmed; WiFi/Bluetooth app (sleep logs) confirmed. products.name: HALO BassiNest Swivel Sleeper 3.0
products.priceNote: MSRP from halosleep.com; some retailers/sales lower (~$219.99); Connected (smart) version $449.99
products.provenance: Re-verified: $279.99 confirmed directly from halosleep.com product page (a Target/sale listing showed $219.99, noted). 20 lb weight limit, breathable mesh walls, and height adjustability (overall height 36–42.5 in; fits beds up to 30 in) confirmed from HALO official page — corrected provenance: the bassinet's OVERALL frame height is 36–42.5 in, not a 23.5–30 in range. 360-degree swivel and lowering wall confirmed. No rocking/vibration and no app on base model.

products.name: Cradlewise Smart Crib
products.priceNote: One-time MSRP from cradlewise.com; delayed-shipping promos discount down to ~$1,399

CORRECTED: the official page states no specific weight limit (use until ~5 months / baby pushes up on hands and knees); the draft's '45 lb' could not be corroborated (secondary sources cite ~30 lb), so max_weight_lb set to null. No rocking or app. Release date not publicly specified.
